zsh-completions.note: No apt package. The zsh module guards on the completion file being present, so its absence only costs completions.

stow.note: Required by link mode; copy mode does not use it.

git.note: The git module sets commit.gpgsign = true, so the signing key must exist before any commit succeeds.

github-cli.note: Packaged under different names: github-cli on Arch, gh on Debian.

openssh.note: Debian splits client and server; only the client is wanted here.

neovim.note: apt's neovim trails the releases the configuration expects, so Debian and Ubuntu take the mise rung.

bat.note: Debian installs the binary as batcat; the zsh module guards on which name exists.

fd.note: Debian installs the binary as fdfind; the zsh module guards on which name exists.

eza.note: Absent from apt on the Debian and Ubuntu releases in use.

mise.note: Deliberately not installed on Arch: it would compete with pacman over the same binaries for no gain. See ADR-0008. On Debian the installer bootstraps it from mise's own apt repository.

nvm.note: Arch packages nvm and it is the native way to juggle Node versions there; on Debian mise already covers Node, so a second manager would be redundant.

nodejs.note: Excluded on Arch because nvm provides Node there.

ghostty.note: Upstream prebuilds for macOS only, leaving a source build or a community .deb.

zed.note: Upstream's Linux route is its own install script, which is a document's business and not the installer's.

android-studio.note: An AUR build on Arch; a tarball from Google elsewhere.

yay.note: The AUR front end, bootstrapped from base-devel and makepkg before any other Arch row is read. Meaningless on Debian.

jq.note: The installer reads this manifest with jq, so jq is installed before the manifest can be read. Its row is documentary. See ADR-0006.
